purpose: Production DesignerApp DPI/theme environment round-trip with resize, semantic bounds, and document state isolation

local.designer_acceptance: passed: resize, DPI, font scale, high contrast, semantic panel bounds, document revision/dirty isolation, ThemeScope reference, edit/save/reopen
local.acceptance_markers: dpi_theme, theme_reference, edit_save_reopen, and window smoke markers are each unique and required

limitations: The automated DPI/theme round-trip validates production state isolation and semantic layout bounds but does not emulate a physical monitor DPI change or signed-in desktop input.
VoiceOver/Narrator/NVDA/Orca speech, real IME, cross-application clipboard, inspector overlays, GPU recovery, clean-machine packaging, and one-hour soak remain separate manual platform checks.
